explication: Lila is the Scala server behind Lichess, a realtime online chess service. A player enters through HTTP routes to create or join a game; game state and records are handled by the game domain, while live connections use the separately hosted WebSocket service. Analysis is a distinct follow-on capability, with distributed engine work supplied by fishnet. The map also retains the README’s major community, learning, competition, and API capabilities. README documents the external architecture; source excerpts sampled here are limited, so uncertain module-to-module wiring is omitted.
